API Documentation

Overview

The MLOps Churn Prediction API provides REST endpoints for model inference, management, and monitoring.

Base URL: http://localhost:8000

Authentication

Currently no authentication required for local deployment.

Endpoints

Health Check

GET /health

Returns system health status and available models.

Response:

{
  "status": "healthy",
  "model_loaded": true,
  "available_models": ["xgboost_20250822_013133"]
}

List Models

GET /models

Parameters:

  • stage (optional): Filter by model stage (staging, production)

Response:

[
  {
    "model_id": "xgboost_20250822_013133",
    "model_type": "xgboost",
    "stage": "staging",
    "created_at": "2025-08-22T01:31:33"
  }
]

Single Prediction

POST /predict

Request Body:

{
  "features": [0.5, 0.3, 0.8, ...],  // 20 features
  "model_id": "xgboost_20250822_013133",
  "stage": "staging"
}

Response:

{
  "prediction": 1,
  "probability": 0.85,
  "model_id": "xgboost_20250822_013133"
}

Batch Prediction

POST /predict/batch

Request Body:

{
  "data": [[0.5, 0.3, ...], [0.8, 0.2, ...]],
  "model_id": "xgboost_20250822_013133",
  "stage": "staging"
}

Model Information

GET /models/{model_id}

Parameters:

  • stage (optional): Model stage

Response:

{
  "model_id": "xgboost_20250822_013133",
  "model_type": "xgboost",
  "performance_metrics": {
    "accuracy": 0.804,
    "precision": 0.82,
    "recall": 0.79,
    "f1_score": 0.80
  }
}

Error Codes

  • 200: Success

  • 400: Bad Request

  • 404: Model Not Found

  • 500: Internal Server Error

Interactive Documentation

Visit http://localhost:8000/docs for interactive Swagger UI documentation.
